_about: Beta 14: the built-in search suggestion services (Settings, Search, "Get suggestions from"). One address per service, %s where the typed text goes, HTTPS only. `hosts` are the search sites whose own engine entry uses this service (stock or added by the person, e.g. Kagi), so such an engine finds it without a suggestion address of its own. Every address was fetched live on `checked` (reply shape: ["typed",["one","two"]]); they change, so this is the one place to update. Read by desktop/search-suggest.cjs and src/runtime/searchSuggest.ts.

services.name: DuckDuckGo
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape, content type application/javascript (so the reply is read by shape, never by content type); sets no cookie

services.name: Brave Search
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape on the first check; every later check from the same address (a few requests, three seconds apart) answered 429 (too many requests), so it is a service that limits by address: re-check from another network

services.name: Startpage
services.note: answered 204 (no content) for every text from the test network; the OpenSearch address its own site advertises (format=opensearch). Re-check from another network

services.name: Ecosia
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape; one first request in four answered 503 (its CDN challenge) and the next ones 200; sets a CDN cookie that is never kept

services.name: Qwant
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape through the opensearch client; the v3 address answers another JSON shape (not used)

services.name: Google
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape plus an extra object; sets a NID cookie that is never kept

services.name: Bing
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape plus extra objects; sets nine cookies that are never kept

services.name: Kagi
services.note: 200, OpenSearch shape; the address a Kagi user gave us (kagisuggest.com, a separate domain with no Kagi session); kagi.com/api/autosuggest answers the same
